source_cells_exact: What does Article 1 cover?
Name of the country ('India, that is Bharat') and type of polity ('Union of States')

source_cells_exact: Ambedkar's 2 reasons for 'Union', not 'Federation'?

source_cells_exact: Why does this wording matter structurally?
Signals India's federation was built top-down (Centre carved states), not bottom-up (states agreeing to federate) — explains Art.3's power
